record_contract.claim_id: A claim_id from the frozen ledger
record_contract.retained_input_ids: Eligible retained node IDs used as direct premises; exclude removed inputs and their descendants
record_contract.derivation_id: Unique identifier for a supported replacement derivation
record_contract.replacement_outcome: Exact substantive claim and scope established on this removal branch
record_contract.derivation: Reviewable inferential steps from the retained premises to the replacement outcome
record_contract.upstream_derivation_ids: Earlier supported derivation IDs from this same removal branch, or [] for a direct route
record_contract.upstream_outcomes_used: Map each upstream ID to the exact replacement_outcome used, preserving weakened scope
record_contract.evidence_refs: Nonempty list of reviewable checkpoint, passage, and output references for a substantive assessment
record_contract.reason: Explanation of equivalence, support, provenance, and any uncertainty
record_contract.replay_protocol: For bounded_model_replay: model_snapshot, settings, input_hash, output_hash, search_budget, completed. Supply hashes of actual inputs/outputs and identify call, token, or time bounds.
record_contract.search_protocol: For bounded_search_review: corpus_boundary, procedure, search_budget, completed. A limited search can provide evidence of non-recovery, not impossibility.
record_contract.note: An evaluator may know the target. Independence concerns the premises and reasoning of the derivation. Missing historical records constrain discovery attribution, not eligibility for this test.
